correctness.rationale: Denisi–Höring Section 3 constructs 0→O(C+)→F→O→0 and identifies the nontrivial Atiyah F2 extension on C_-. Because f_*O(C+)=O_E⊕N, R1=0 and the defining section spans O_E, its class is the pushout from E. On any ruling F|P1=O(1)⊕O, hence R1 f_*Sym^m F=0. The fiberwise monomials z^j a^i b^{m-j-i} form a basis, and their transition b↦b+c a fixes j and acts as the single unipotent Jordan block of rank m-j+1; this yields the stated direct-sum decomposition. Atiyah bundles contribute h0(F_r)=1 at j=0; positive-degree N^j⊗F_r has h0=rjd, h1=0. Summing j(m-j+1)=binom(m+2,3), and Denisi–Höring equation (10) identifies graded section rings R(T_M) and R(F). Independent binomial checks m=0..30 and the nilpotent single-Jordan-block condition dimensions 2..8 corroborated, but all-degree proof is geometric.
